svg.title: Stu (@stu-titor). Currently a computer science student at the University of Texas at Austin. My work spans across software, data, and systems engineering, as well as machine learning and cloud computing. Interested in all facets of computers. A punched FORTRAN card reading: PRINT *, "HELLO, I'M STU. I BUILD THINGS FROM THE BOTTOM UP."
